messages:
jen: hey team — EdgeCo POC starts tomorrow. Need a hosted API key for their sandbox harness. Requirements: expiry ~30 days, IP allowlist for their test runners, and limited scope (generate calls only). Can someone do quick handoff? cc @lia
omar: I can. Do you want ephemeral key or managed short-lived rotated key? Ephemeral = one-time token (24h). Managed = console key with automated rotation (we can set 14d).
jen: Managed preferred so their CI can persist it. Rotation cadence: 14 days. Lifetime overall 30 days. Scope: generate + streaming only. No embeddings or admin. Also need audit logs enabled.
lia: Got it. I need the IP CIDRs and the customer contact email to tag the key and put in the allowlist.
jen: IPs: 34.82.10.0/24 and 3.5.6.7/32. subdomain: edgeco.sandbox.redwood-example.com. Contact: infra@edgeco.com. Also add rate limits: 50 req/s, burst 200.
omar: Thanks. I'll create key with label 'edgeco-sandbox-poc' and enable rotation + audit logging. Will scope to [generate, stream]. ETA ~15m.
deploy-bot: Key created: key_id=rwk_7f9c3d, expires=1927360000, scopes=[generate,stream], ip_allowlist=[34.82.10.0/24,3.5.6.7/32], rate_limit=50r/s, owner=jen
lia: Scheduled automatic rotation at day 14 and final revocation at day 30. Added owner note and ACL. Pushed short onboarding snippet to the customer docs: 
```
# rotate via admin API
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/keys/rotate \\n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \\n  -d '{"key_id":"rwk_7f9c3d"}'
```
jen: Perfect. Can you also confirm we won't hit Dedicated pool fallbacks? EdgeCo asked about latency — this is on hosted.
omar: Checked routing: hosted pool in us-west has capacity and is pinned for this key. Fallback to dedicated only on severe capacity pressure; not expected for a POC at this volume.
jen: :thumbsup: Thanks all. I'll send the onboarding email to infra@edgeco.com with the key id and usage docs. Lia, ping me if they need IP changes.
